baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 supplies a screened garden, word 3 crosses into it, and words 7 and 11 place concentric forms of enclosure on the body; the locative is repeated.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse contracts protection from habitat to wrist to skin. Entry does not end at arrival: the entrants become bodily fitted to the protected interior they inhabit.

activation_trace.role: A garden screened by its growth supplies the outer inhabited enclosure.
Literal passage into an interior makes the promised place a crossed boundary.
The ornament literally circles the wrist and miniaturizes the garden's enclosure on the body.
Bodily covering completes the nested sequence at skin scale.

changed_reading.before: A destination followed by a list of luxury goods.
changed_reading.after: A sequence of benevolent enclosures in which place, ornament, and clothing progressively secure the entrant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The passive adornment at word 4 is followed by metal, pearl, and a garment whose location is again specified.
baseline_models.mechanism: Adornment acts as a visible description of the entrants rather than merely property near them. Metal color, pearl light, and fine cloth make an inwardly changed condition outwardly legible.

activation_trace.role: Literal ornament grounds the passive transformation in something worn.
The branch of description lets ornament function as a visible account of the wearer.
The red-yellow color range supplies chromatic visibility to the bodily display.
Visible shimmer makes the transformed state radiate rather than remain private.
Fine cloth gives the visible state a continuous tactile surface.

changed_reading.after: The entrants are made visibly readable through color, radiance, and clothing; the objects describe a transformed state.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final garment combines the clothing root with a silk root whose inventory also carries freedom and release from defect.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can hold protection without hardness: covering and even armor-like security remain, but silk recodes them as free, refined, and non-coercive rather than defensive confinement.

activation_trace.role: Wearable protection supplies the defensive side of clothing.
Freedom from bondage converts covering from restraint into release.
Freedom from flaw gives the textile an ethical and material refinement.
Literal fine silk keeps the release reading anchored in the stated garment.

changed_reading.before: Silk is a luxury textile added after jewelry.
changed_reading.after: Silk is an exploratory material figure for protected freedom: a covering that secures without binding.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early opening-and-withholding contrast converts entry into granted access. The garden remains enclosed, but its boundary is opened as mercy and cannot be barred by a competing holder.

activation_trace.role: Entry into an interior is the focus-side event needing access.
Opening a closure and widening an entrance supplies the access mechanism.
Merciful tenderness identifies the opened access as gift rather than conquest.
Holding or restraining supplies the blocked alternative that the context denies.

structural_cues: 35:2 places opening, mercy, and failed withholding before 35:33's movement into an interior.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an opened mercy that no one can hold back and a later entrance; I treat the former as the causal access condition for the latter. The live alternative is that 35:2 governs providence generally and does not specify this doorway.

changed_reading.before: The entrants simply cross into a bounded garden.
changed_reading.after: They cross a boundary opened as mercy, so enclosure and accessibility become complementary rather than opposed.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier passive beautification makes bad action look good; the focus uses another passive adornment scene. The warning makes final beauty diagnostic only when exterior, wearer, and destination agree, turning it into the counter-image of a deceptive surface.

activation_trace.role: Making beauty appear supplies the earlier case in which an attractive exterior misdescribes action.
Literal bestowed ornament supplies the later visible surface.
Adornment as description lets the later exterior truthfully characterize its wearer.

structural_cues: 35:8 and 35:33 both foreground passive adornment, but the former joins it to mis-seeing bad action while the latter follows garden entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two passive adornment scenes with opposite settings; I infer a deceptive-versus-vindicated contrast. A live alternative is that the two distinct adornment verbs are not intended as a formal pair.

changed_reading.before: The ornaments are self-evident tokens of honor.
changed_reading.after: Their force lies in being a truthful exterior after the surah has shown that beauty can lie; setting and wearer validate the surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The worldly scene has people bring ornament out of concealment and put it on themselves while seeking bounty. The focus repeats ornament and clothing but changes the agency: they enter, then are adorned, and their clothing is simply present there. Acquisition becomes reception.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something out of concealment supplies the labor of worldly acquisition.
Literal ornament gives a direct material precursor to the focus adornment.
Active self-covering supplies the worldly agency that the focus recasts.
Gift and beneficence prevent extraction from becoming an autonomous economy.
Passive adornment receives and transforms the earlier ornament action.
The stated garment is possessed in the destination rather than narrated as self-applied.

structural_cues: 35:12 coordinates active extraction and active wearing; 35:33 coordinates active entering with passive adornment and a nominal clothing clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ornament and clothing roots with changed grammar; I infer a shift from human acquisition to bestowed condition. The alternative is that passive voice and nominal possession are ordinary stylistic variation.

changed_reading.before: Paradisal jewelry is a richer version of ornament people obtain and wear in the world.
changed_reading.after: The repeated materials expose a change of agency: worldly ornament is extracted and self-worn, while the final state is received and maintained for its entrants.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that names the scorching member of an earlier shade-versus-heat pair returns in the focus as fine silk. The final garment can therefore carry a tactile reversal: destructive heat is not merely absent but revoiced as soft covering and freedom.

activation_trace.role: Protective shade supplies the sheltering pole of the earlier contrast.
Literal heat supplies the hostile tactile state that the focus root later transforms.
Literal silk realizes the same root as a fine wearable surface.
Freedom gives the tactile reversal a release dimension rather than mere climate comfort.

structural_cues: 35:21 opposes shade and scorching heat; 35:33 ends on a silk noun resolved to the same root as that heat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies root identity and opposite tactile scenes; I supply the arrow from heat to silk as a material reversal. The live alternative is ordinary polysemy with no intended callback.

changed_reading.before: Silk is the last luxury in the list.
changed_reading.after: Silk becomes an embodied reversal of scorching exposure: the threatening root returns as sheltering softness and release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated differentiation of visible surfaces across fruit, mountains, people, and creatures scales down onto the entrants. Gold color, pearl radiance, and descriptive adornment make created variation wearable rather than merely observed.

activation_trace.role: Visible complexion across fruit and mountains supplies a world-scale field of differentiated surfaces.
Acquiring a new color brings the differentiation from landscape onto living bodies.
The metal's color range condenses the earlier chromatic field into ornament.
Shimmer adds changing light to the entrants' visible surface.
Adornment as description makes the created display characterize its wearer.

structural_cues: 35:27-28 repeat visible differentiation across landscape and bodies immediately before the reward sequence of 35:29-33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated color taxonomy and later chromatic and luminous materials; I infer a scale change from creation viewed to creation worn. The alternative is a general beauty sequence without this condensation.

changed_reading.before: Gold and pearl indicate undifferentiated wealth.
changed_reading.after: The materials gather the surah's differentiated creation onto human surfaces, making transformed identity visibly particular.

context_deltas.mechanism: A trade that does not perish is first paid in full and then increased. Repeated bounty language surrounds the focus, while one bounty branch itself pictures draped cloth. Jewelry and silk therefore render not the settled wage alone but a gifted surplus that wraps the recipients.

activation_trace.role: Trade and sought profit establish the account-like frame.
Completion without deficiency closes the wage side of the account.
Growth beyond completion opens a surplus after full payment.
Excess and remainder identify the increase as more than equivalence.
Gift and beneficence frame the inherited outcome before the focus.
The rare draped-cloth branch gives surrounding bounty a literal garment-shaped resonance.
The actual garment supplies the focus anchor for surplus becoming wearable.

structural_cues: 35:29-30 moves from non-perishing trade to full payment and then increase; bounty recurs in 35:32 and 35:35 on both sides of 35:33.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies account completion, added bounty, repeated bounty references, and a cloth branch; I infer that the focus materials visualize surplus. The alternative is that every item belongs to recompense generally, with no allocation between wage and increase.

changed_reading.before: The listed goods are the payment owed for prior action.
changed_reading.after: They are the visible and wearable excess that begins only after the account has already been paid in full.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding verse first names selected book-inheritors, then distributes them across three singular class labels. The plural entry can recollect that divided population, making one garden interior hold morally unequal trajectories without erasing their difference.

activation_trace.role: Transmission of book or virtue supplies the broad antecedent group.
Selection defines the group before its internal division.
The middle position makes one distinct trajectory in the three-part distribution.
Precedence supplies the leading trajectory without dissolving the earlier collective.
Permission makes even precedence authorized rather than self-secured.
Plural entry supplies the possible re-gathering of the divided antecedent.

structural_cues: 35:32 begins with one selected inheritor group, partitions it into three generic singular classes, and 35:33 opens with a plural destination clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a collective antecedent, internal partition, and following plural; I let the plural resume the broad collective. The materially live alternative is attachment to the nearest leading class alone.

changed_reading.before: The plural entrants are an unspecified rewarded group.
changed_reading.after: One plausible scope gathers all three classes of selected inheritors into the same protected destination despite their unequal paths.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearest class is the one that precedes in good acts by permission, immediately followed by the declaration of great bounty. On this narrower attachment, entry and adornment mark the leading class's distinctive outcome rather than common convergence.

activation_trace.role: Advancing ahead supplies the nearest candidate class for the following plural.
Movement toward beneficial good specifies what distinguishes that class.
Authorization keeps the class's precedence dependent rather than autonomous.
Degree and excellence support a differentiated rather than leveled outcome.
The plural entry is the disputed predicate attached to the nearest class in this model.
Visible description lets adornment mark the class's distinct standing.

structural_cues: The leading-in-good class, its permission phrase, and the great-bounty clause are the nearest material before the plural entry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proximity and a differentiated leading class; I allow nearest-class attachment. The equally live alternative is that the plural reaches back over all three classes to the original selected collective.

changed_reading.before: The plural entrants are an unspecified rewarded group.
changed_reading.after: A second plausible scope restricts the regalia-bearing entrants to the foremost class, preserving rank differentiation at the threshold.

context_deltas.mechanism: The gold root repeatedly carries going or removal, becomes metal in the focus, and immediately returns as caused removal of sorrow. At the hinge, what departs changes: neither the self nor the rewarded people are sent away; grief is, while gold remains on the body.

activation_trace.role: Going supplies the earlier danger of a self being spent in regret.
Caused removal supplies the possibility that people themselves are made to pass away.
Literal gold arrests the repeated root as a durable object on the entrant.
Immediate caused removal redirects the root's motion onto sorrow.
The roughness of grief identifies what is removed from the newly adorned body.

structural_cues: The focus's metal use of the root is followed in the next ayah by the same root as removal of sorrow, after earlier going and removal uses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence and immediate juxtaposition; I infer a semantic pivot in what is allowed to go. The live alternative is unactivated homonymy between metal and motion.

changed_reading.before: Gold is a static precious material.
changed_reading.after: Gold becomes a durable marker of selective departure: grief has gone, while the entrants and their adornment remain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah turns arrival into settled residence and negates both exertion and fatigue. The repeated locative around jewelry and clothing therefore marks an ongoing habitat fitted to the body, not a brief investiture ceremony.

activation_trace.role: The screened garden supplies the habitat whose duration is clarified next.
Entry supplies the initial transition that becomes settlement.
Taking up a place converts arrival into lodging.
Residence and belonging to a home give the garden social and spatial continuity.
Staying in a place supplies explicit duration to the residence.
Exhausting toil is named as a condition that no longer reaches the residents.
Weakness and fatigue are excluded from the continuing bodily state.
Continuous covering ties bodily ease to the permanent environment.

structural_cues: 35:35 immediately resumes the speakers of 35:34, names their permanent abode, and twice negates bodily strain within it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate continuation from entry to residence and no fatigue; I read 35:35 as a temporal gloss on 35:33's repeated locative. The alternative is that permanence describes only the abode and adds nothing to the ornaments.

changed_reading.before: Entry culminates in a moment of ceremonial adornment.
changed_reading.after: Entry opens into permanent, effortless habitation; jewelry and silk are stable properties of life there, not temporary regalia.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the wrist-ornament branch belongs to holding verbs in 35:2 and 35:41, not to an ornament token there. It remains anchored because that exact branch meets the focus bracelet and the context contrasts withheld mercy with cosmic preservation. Render it only as an exploratory topology of benevolent holding, never as a lexical gloss of either verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus bracelet encircles the wrist inside an enduring protected place.

activation_trace.role: The root's wrist-ornament branch places a bracelet image inside the denied act of withholding mercy.
Literal holding supplies preservation of the larger created order.
Departure from place or state names the collapse that holding prevents.
The literal wrist-circling ornament anchors the small-scale bodily version of holding.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it figures a sustaining hold that neither withholds mercy nor permits the adorned life to lapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading crosses distant branches of the garden root, so it must not claim that the focus garden means a grave. It remains valid as a transformation of shared concealment: resurrection and graves activate a move from burial-covering to living, protective enclosure. Downstream prose should mark it as a spatial resonance, not an alternate dictionary sense in context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 1 names the garden through a root whose inventory includes both vegetated screening and burial concealment.

activation_trace.role: Reviving the dead supplies the transfer out of death rather than mere relocation.
Burial concealment supplies the prior enclosure from which the transformed reading departs.
The root's burial-covering branch keeps the former enclosure attached to the focus word without replacing its surface sense.
The living screened garden supplies the new enclosure after emergence.

changed_reading.before: The garden is only the destination reached after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, resurrection changes the mode of concealment itself: burial covering is reopened as a living and protective garden enclosure.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The garment branch of bounty is rare and cross-domain, so it should not replace the ordinary gift or surplus sense. It remains unusually well anchored because bounty recurs immediately before and after a focus verse that explicitly supplies clothing. Render it as a secondary materialization: generosity wraps the recipients.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus ends by assigning the entrants a garment within the garden.

activation_trace.role: The draped-cloth side branch gives the first nearby bounty occurrence a wearable shape.
The bounty occurrence directly before the focus repeats the wrapping image.
The bounty occurrence directly after the focus completes the verbal frame around the garment.
Literal bodily covering anchors the repeated side-branch image in an explicit focus object.

changed_reading.before: Bounty causes or funds the clothing reward.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory material level, bounty itself wraps the entrants and becomes their garment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This depends on the packet's non-dominant mapped root for the lodging verb and is therefore form-distant. It remains structurally legitimate because the split inventory explicitly supplies the same adornment root used in the focus, beside ordinary lodging and clothing branches. Render it as an audible or latent convergence of installation and investiture, never as a claim that the lodging verb literally means adornment here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs entry, passive adornment, and clothing; the next ayah names being installed in the permanent residence.

activation_trace.role: Ordinary taking up of a place grounds the next ayah in actual residence.
The same dominant inventory also carries a suit of clothes, linking installation to investiture.
The non-dominant mapped target supplies ornament as a latent side activation of the lodging event.
The explicit focus adornment anchors the side activation to the actual verse.
The explicit focus garment anchors the clothing side of the convergence.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, being installed in the permanent home and being invested with its clothing are two surfaces of one transformation.

strongest_changes: The repeated ornament and clothing roots change agency from extraction and self-wearing in 35:12 to bestowed and continuously possessed adornment in 35:33.
The metal root becomes a semantic hinge: earlier people or the self may go, but after the focus gold remains while sorrow is made to depart.
The heat root returns as silk, allowing the final garment to embody a tactile reversal from scorching exposure to soft protection and freedom.
Full payment followed by increase, plus repeated bounty on both sides of the focus, makes the jewelry and garment readable as gifted surplus rather than equivalent wages.
The plural entry retains two plausible scopes: all three selected inheritor classes may converge, or the nearest foremost class may be singled out.
summary.what_was_special: Direct root recurrences across the focus changed material nouns into transitions of agency, climate, and affect. Rare packet branches also made holding resemble a bracelet, bounty resemble draped cloth, and the next ayah's split lodging root resonate with adornment without displacing ordinary senses.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent range of the plural entry remains genuinely forked between the broad selected group and the nearest foremost class.
The metal/removal and heat/silk pivots may be deliberate semantic reversals or simply activated polysemy.
The passive adornment does not state its agent inside the focus ayah, so the bestowal reading depends on grammatical contrast and surrounding gift language.
The wrist-hold, garment-bounty, and split-root lodging activations are valid exploratory resonances but should not be promoted to direct lexical glosses.
